description: Use when the user asks how body areas compare for pain, fading, sun, friction, stretch or curvature, or which areas hold ink longest. Returns the ten common areas (or the ones requested), ordered by fade by default. Estimates are coarse 0-100 comparisons, not measurements.

placements.description: Areas to compare. Omit for all ten.

sort_by.description: Order, lowest first. Defaults to fade.
